description: This file defines the CustomerOptionSetService interface in a customer attribute package within the shopizer project. It specifies methods for managing CustomerOptionSet entities, including saving, updating, and listing sets based on various criteria such as store, option, and option value.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetService
classes.description: Service interface for managing customer option sets, extending generic entity service for CustomerOptionSet entities.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOptionSet or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSets filtered by MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: listByOption
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSets associated with a specific CustomerOption and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSets associated with a specific CustomerOptionValue and MerchantStore.
